- Move to Wed, 2026-05-06 at 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 BST / 03:00 JST — still awkward.
- Or schedule two shorter sessions for APAC and for US/EU the same week (30 min each).

We should also be mindful of upcoming regional holidays later this year (Diwali window in Oct/Nov) as Finova plans rollout windows — happy to work around those too when we set longer-term checkpoints.

Draft agenda I'll attach in a follow up (slides + short tech checklist). If you prefer, Marissa can own the scheduling and send a calendar invite for the confirmed slot.
